defs.def: to make sb feel less tired or less hot 使恢复精力；使凉爽

ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 身处大自然使我们精神焕发。

ex.s: If you can find something else to concentrate for a while, you will most certainly feel much more refreshed later on.
ex.t: 如果你能找到别的事情专注一会儿，之后你肯定会感到精神好了很多。

ex.s: It will ___58___ (undoubted) help you get refreshed!
ex.t: 温泉的神奇之处在于温度越低，泉水越___59___（hot/热）！

defs.def: to fill sb's glass or cup again 重新斟满
to remind yourself/sb of sth, especially with the help of sth that can be seen or heard 提醒；提示；使想起

ex.s: At worst, you will have refreshed and deepened your knowledge of the rules you normally apply, so that you can be even more effective next time.
ex.t: 最坏的情况是，你复习并加深了对通常所运用规则的理解，以便下次能更加高效。

ex.s: It is refreshing to think that there was once such a person who did not just speak wise words to live by, but who also put those words into practice during his own life.
ex.t: 令人耳目一新的是，想到曾经有一个人，他不仅说出智慧的格言让人遵循，而且在自己的一生中也将这些话付诸实践。

defs.def: to get the most recent information, for example on an Internet page, by clicking on a button on the screen 刷新；更新；重新整理

ex.s: Going outside, the author feels refreshed and realises he has been 9________.
ex.t: 走到外面，作者感到精神焕发，并意识到他一直在________。

ex.s: I get refreshed through climbing, spend more time with my dad, and get to meet new friends.
ex.t: 通过攀岩我得到了放松，花了更多时间陪我爸爸，还能认识新朋友。

ex.s: Potential benefits Moral concerns will lead to cures for various has refreshed the technical possibility of diseases cloning of other species Read the last paragraph.What does Einstein's quote mean?
ex.t: 潜在益处 道德担忧 将带来各种疾病的治疗方法 已经刷新了其他物种克隆的技术可能性 读最后一段。爱因斯坦的名言是什么意思？
